description_en: Applies for a host or database O&M token to perform O&M operations on assets
description_zh: 您可以通过该接口申请主机或数据库运维令牌，并通过运维令牌运维资产
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost generate-asset-operation-token --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --asset-type Host --asset-id 11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GenerateAssetOperationToken

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the Bastionhost instance for which you want to apply for an O&M token.
You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to obtain the value of this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定要申请运维令牌操作所在堡垒机的实例ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取该参数
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Bastionhost instance.
For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的地域ID。
地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/40654.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The Asset Type for which you want to apply for a token. Valid values:
Host: host
Database: database
parameters.help_zh:
指定要申请令牌的资产类型。取值：
Host：主机。
Database：数据库
parameters.name: asset_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the asset for which you want to apply for an O&M token
parameters.help_zh: 需要申请运维令牌的资产ID
parameters.name: asset_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the asset account for which you want to apply for an O&M token.
You must specify at least one of AssetAccountId and AssetAccountName. If both are specified, AssetAccountId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
申请运维令牌的资产账户ID。
AssetAccountId和AssetAccountName需要至少指定一个，当同时指定时，优先使用AssetAccountId
parameters.name: asset_account_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the host account. If the account is a custom account, specify the actual account name.

If both AssetAccountId and AssetAccountName are specified, AssetAccountId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
主机账号名，当为自定义账号时，填写真实账户名。

当AssetAccountId和AssetAccountName同时指定时，优先使用AssetAccountId
parameters.name: asset_account_name

parameters.help_en: The Base64-encoded password. This parameter is required when you apply for an O&M token for a custom account
parameters.help_zh: base64后的密码。当为自定义账号申请运维令牌时必填
parameters.name: asset_account_password

parameters.help_en:
The name of the protocol. Valid values:

SSH
RDP
Oracle
PostgreSQL
MySQL
SQLServer

This parameter is required when you apply for an O&M token for a custom account
parameters.help_zh:
协议名称。取值：

SSH
RDP
Oracle
PostgreSQL
MySQL
SQLServer

当为自定义账号申请运维令牌时必填
parameters.name: asset_account_protocol_name

parameters.help_en:
The O&M logon method. Valid values:
WebToken: obtain an O&M token
Sso: log on by using a local client
This parameter is supported only in Bastionhost V3.2.44 and later. If this parameter is left empty, the default value WebToken is used
parameters.help_zh:
运维登录方式。取值：
WebToken：获取运维令牌。
Sso：本地客户端登录。
仅支持V3.2.44及以上版本使用，为空时默认取值为WebToken
parameters.name: operation_mode

parameters.help_en:
The logon attribute. This parameter is required when OperationMode is set to Sso and the account is a custom Oracle account. Valid values:
SERVICENAME
SID
This parameter is supported only in Bastionhost V3.2.44 and later
parameters.help_zh:
登录属性，当OperationMode为Sso且账户为Oracle类型自定义账户时必须指定，取值：
SERVICENAME
SID
仅支持V3.2.44及以上版本使用
parameters.name: login_attribute

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database. This parameter is required when OperationMode is set to Sso, AssetAccountProtocolName is set to PostgreSQL or Oracle, and the account is a custom account.
This parameter is supported only in Bastionhost V3.2.44 and later
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名。当OperationMode为Sso且AssetAccountProtocolName为PostgreSQL或Oracle，且为自定义账户时，DatabaseSchema为必填。
仅支持V3.2.44及以上版本使用
parameters.name: database_schema

parameters.help_en:
The type of the local client to be opened for O&M operations on Linux assets. This parameter is required when OperationMode is set to Sso and the asset protocol is SSH. Valid values:
ssh: open an SSH client to perform O&M operations with SSH permissions
sftp: open an SFTP client to perform O&M operations with SFTP permissions
This parameter is supported only in Bastionhost V3.2.44 and later
parameters.help_zh:
linux资产运维需打开的本地客户端类型。当OperationMode为Sso且资产协议为SSH时必传。取值：
ssh：打开SSH协议客户端，以SSH权限进行运维。
sftp：打开SFTP协议客户端，以SFTP权限进行运维。
仅支持V3.2.44及以上版本使用
parameters.name: sso_client

parameters.help_en: The logon note. This parameter is required when the administrator enables the logon note feature in the control policy
parameters.help_zh: 登录备注。当管理员在控制策略中开启了登录备注时为必填
parameters.name: operation_note

CountLeft.description_en: The remaining number of times the O&M token can be used
CountLeft.description_zh: 运维令牌剩余可使用的次数

ExpireTime.description_en: The expiration time of the O&M token. The value is a UNIX timestamp
ExpireTime.description_zh: 运维令牌过期时间。时间戳格式

HasCountLimit.description_en: Indicates whether the number of uses is limited

MaxRenewCount.description_en: The maximum number of times the token can be renewed. A value of 0 indicates that the token cannot be renewed
MaxRenewCount.description_zh: 最大续期次数，0表示不可续期

RenewCount.description_en: The number of times the token has been renewed

TokenId.description_en: The ID of the O&M token

RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符
